title: ohho.sweep.run/v1
description: Persisted OhhO training sweep. sampler is ohho.sweep.sampler/v1. trials is the trial table. Each trial seed is the training seed derived from the sweep seed and the trial index. dataset_version_id, when set, is the dataset version selected for that trial. values null means the trial was proposed and not told. status pruned means early stopping stopped the trial; that is distinct from failed. A pruned or failed trial keeps checkpoint and metrics. Restoring this document continues the sampler from the saved generator without repeating a trial index and keeps pruned and failed status.

seed.description: Training seed derived from the sweep seed and this trial index.

dataset_version_id.description: Dataset version id selected for this trial. Omitted when the trial did not apply a dataset dimension.

status.description: pending has no intermediate report. running has a report and has not stopped. completed was told final objectives. pruned was stopped by early stopping. failed is a trainer failure and is not pruned.

checkpoint.description: Last checkpoint path reported by the trial runner. Kept when the trial is pruned or failed.

metrics.description: Intermediate reports for early_stopping.metric, in increasing step order. Kept when the trial is pruned or failed.

decision.description: Frozen continue decision for the latest step. stop is recorded by status pruned.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed. Null when the trial is pruned.
